title: Attachment picker
summary: The sheet from the attach button: photos and videos from the library, the camera, or a file. The choice goes to media-upload-preview.

options.description: In this order. camera only when the phone has one.

cameraDenied.description: The camera permission is off. Shows bipe_camera_permission_body with a button to the system settings.

pickLibrary.effect: Opens the system photo picker (PHPicker on iOS, the Android photo picker) for images and videos, up to 10. No library permission is needed.

takePhoto.effect: Asks for the camera permission at this moment if needed, then opens the system camera for a photo or a video.

pickFile.effect: Opens the system document picker for any file.

notes: Permissions in context: the camera is asked for only on a camera action (onboarding.md, Permissions). A refusal never blocks the other options.
Location, polls and contacts are not in this sheet in phase 1. Polls are groups work (bipe-chat/bipe#569).
